_format: Each entry: { id, caption, scheduledAt (ISO 8601, UTC), screenshotTab (optional — matches index.html's ?tab= values, e.g. "sapphirerush", "trending"; omit for the default landing view), status }. Status starts as "approved" once the user has signed off on the caption/schedule — the workflow only ever posts entries whose status is "approved" and whose scheduledAt has passed. It rewrites status to "posted" (+ postedAt, tweetId) or "failed" (+ lastError) afterward. Add new entries by asking Claude, or by editing this file directly and committing.
